spans.s: Legal impurity or contamination; defilement caused either by child-birth (called जननाशौच) or by the death of some relation (called मृताशौच); it lasts for 1 days; during the मृताशौच a person defiled by it is not to touch anybody else, or to eat with others in the 'same row or to do any sacred action; अहोरात्रमुपासी- रन्नशौचं बान्धवैः सह
. -Comp. -अन्तः end of defilement. -संकरः blending or coming together of two or more defilements.
] Impurity, see अशौचम्; दशाहं शावमाशौचं सपिण्डेषु विधीयते
असौनामन् [asaunāman], a. Ved. Having such and such a name. असौ नामायमिदं रूपः Bṛi.
असौम्य [asaumya], a. Not lovely, ugly, disagreeable; ˚कृत a. Troublesome; ममापि सो$पराध्नोति यो युष्माकमसौम्यकृत्
. ˚स्वर a. having a bad or croaking voice.
Devoid of beauty or loveliness, not in good trim; शरीरमसौष्ठवम्
Ugly, deformed.-वम् Worthlessness, absence of merit.
